{{Quote|Defeat me, and a hundred more will come for you.|Sakan Do'nair during his last fight|<ref name="TOR:BP" />}}
'''Sakan Do'nair''' was a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Master Do'nair along with a battalion of Jedi Knights were assigned to aid in the protection of the ancient Rakatan [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]] in the [[Nanth'ri system/Legends|Nanth'ri system]] under the command of the Prodigal Knight [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] during the latter half of the Cold War. While in transit to the Foundry aboard the [[Dorin's Sky]], the ship came under attack by an Imperial attack force led by the [[White Nova (Harrower-class)|White Nova]] under the command of [[Moff]] [[Phennir (Moff)|Phenir]] on orders from [[Darth Malgus]]. Master Do'nair lead several Jedi against the vanguard of the boarding party, but perished in battle.<ref name="TOR:BP" />
